contribution.position: My position is unchanged: reliability evidence is still incomplete. The tests (412 passed, 0 failed, 87% coverage) and the peak-load p99 result are good, but neither covers retry-storm behavior in the rebuild job. Retry storms caused both sev2 incidents last quarter. The ops turn cites artifact:rollback-rehearsal-q3 as proof of a clean rollback rehearsal, but that id is not in the artifact list and the turn lists no anchors. The runbook (artifact:ops-runbook) states that no rollback rehearsal has been run for this job. Until the rehearsal artifact is produced, I treat the recovery path as untested. Two items would settle this: a retry-storm or failure-injection result for the rebuild job, and either the actual rehearsal record or one new rehearsed rollback with a timing measurement. Cost and schedule are outside my axis.
